description: Dry run of a netting proposal: asks the contract (view simulate_clearing) whether the edges would be accepted for an epoch and how much debt they would cancel. Use it to check a proposal before a solver submits it; to see what a finished epoch actually netted use x207_epoch_report. Returns {epoch, edgeCount, result}. An invalid proposal (unknown member, amount above the debt, wrong epoch phase) comes back as an error text from the contract. Read-only, sends nothing.

edges.description: 1 to 300 debt edges; a cycle of edges nets to zero cash.

cleared.description: Debt to cancel on this edge, a decimal string in the smallest unit (6 decimals), at most what the debtor owes.

epoch.description: The epoch the proposal is for; it must be one that can still accept a clearing.

name: x207_simulate_clearing
title: Simulate a clearing proposal
